title: TeraWulf secures a credit backstop agreement with Google to support financing for its data center project with Anthropic in Kentucky, set to come online H2 2027 (Deborah Sophia/Reuters)
summary: Deborah Sophia / Reuters: TeraWulf secures a credit backstop agreement with Google to support financing for its data center project with Anthropic in Kentucky, set to come online H2 2027 — Data-center developer TeraWulf (WULF.O) said on Wednesday it has secured a credit backstop agreement with Alphabet's Google …
